primary:
You have $7 million to spend in downtown West Palm Beach. Which tower should you choose?

Two new towers on the same street. One has 275 residences and a resort-style lifestyle. The other has 98 and just four residences per floor.

Tour both with us and see which one fits you. The sales office works for the developer, we work for you. (But the developer pays us.) Win/win.

*Estimated, based on currently available residences as of Nov. 2026. Subject to change without notice.

Before you fall for the view, compare what it costs to own it.

Monthly HOA works out to about $1.13 per square foot in one waterfront tower and about $1.95 in the one next door. On a 2,500 sq ft residence, that gap adds up fast.

We'll show you both side by side. The sales office works for the developer, we work for you. (But the developer pays us.) Win/win.

*Estimated, based on currently available residences as of Nov. 2026. Subject to change without notice.

Resort or retreat?

Same street in downtown West Palm Beach. Very different ways to live. Tour both with us and decide.

The sales office works for the developer, we work for you. (But the developer pays us.) Win/win.
